title.rendered: Professional Wedding DJ & Disc Jockey in North Bay, San Francisco Bay Area

content.rendered:
California Disc Jockey was established in 1988, and has established itself as a leading provider of disc jockey services in the great San Francisco area. Over the years we’ve worked some fantastic events, and helped the likes of Google, Facebook and the USA Polo Team get down and party.

Please fill in our contact form to get a quote for your 2026 event.

We also provide wireless led uplighting, photo booths, karaoke, Gobo packages and much, much more.
 Contact us to discuss your event, and to get a competitive quote. 

All Inclusive DJ MC Package Bundles Wireless Led Uplighting • Photo Booths • Gobo Monogram

North Bay, San Francisco CA

We’re proud to be a part of the San Francisco community, and be of service to the North Bay area. We cover Santa Rosa, Vallejo, San Rafael, Fairfield, Napa, Novato, Petaluma, Rohnert Park – and everywhere else in between!

About California Disc Jockey

Chris Webb, the man behind the DJ booth, founded California Disc Jockey in the late 80s and has established himself as a leading DJ in the San Francisco area. Call him on (415) 350 5474 or (707) 263 7690 to talk about your event, your music or even to get help with planning your event!

DJ’ing at Mountain View for Google’s 11th Birthday Party.

Emergency Party Planning Available ! Stop worrying about it!
Call us ☎ 415-350-5474

Contact Us For Your Special Event

Other areas in the North Bay area that we cover are:


Auburn, Belvedere, Bodega Bay, Bolinas, Boonville, Calistoga, Chico, Cloverdale, Corte Madera, Davis, Dixon, Eldorado Hills, Eureka, Fairfax, Fairfield, Folsom, Forestville, Greenbrae, Healdsburg, Hopland, Humboldt, Kentifield, Lake Tahoe, Lakeport, Larkspur, Marin, Marysville, Mendocino Coast  Mill Valley, Mt Shasta Redding Roseville Ross Rutherford Sacramento San Anselmo San Rafael San Francisco Santa Rosa, Sausalito, Sebastopol, Solano, Sonoma, St Helena, Stinson Beach, Suisan, Tiburon, Williams Willits Windsor Yountville Yuba
